_runner: No automated runner. Each eval is a prompt plus an assertion checklist; verify manually or with an agent, assertion by assertion.

evals.prompt: Create an IEEE-style campus network paper figure with core, distribution, and access layers in grayscale. Return the editable source and an IEEE submission-ready vector artifact, with sidecars in a work directory.
evals.expected_output: A grayscale-safe IEEE campus network figure with editable drawio and an accepted vector-submission artifact.
assertions: Uses drawio-academic-skills overlay policy
Calls or references sibling ../drawio for CLI execution
Sets meta.profile to academic-paper
Sets meta.figureType to architecture
Sets manifest.contract.delivery_class to vector-submission and requires PDF/PS/EPS rather than live-text SVG for IEEE
Includes caption or legend guidance for IEEE-style symbols

evals.prompt: Create a research workflow figure for a manuscript showing data collection, preprocessing, modeling, validation, and reporting.
evals.expected_output: An editable workflow plus draft preview because the manuscript venue and publication target are not fixed.
assertions: Sets meta.figureType to workflow
Uses academic or academic-color theme based on color policy
Sets delivery_class to draft-preview, delivers .drawio plus preview SVG, and does not claim publication completion
Keeps .spec.yaml, .arch.json, and manifest in a work directory
Does not require MCP or live backend

evals.prompt: Create a system architecture paper figure with client, API, worker, and storage layers. Make it readable in a two-column paper.
evals.expected_output: A paper-facing architecture diagram with compact labels and publication checks.
assertions: Sets meta.figureType to architecture
Uses concise labels before shrinking fonts
Preserves caption-ready title and one-sentence description
Runs sibling base CLI validation with strict warnings or equivalent

evals.prompt: Create a paper-ready YOLO-style object detection architecture figure. Show input image, backbone, neck/fusion, detection heads, and loss/output. Use editable draw.io primitives, compact labels, and deliver .drawio plus .svg with sidecars in a work directory.
evals.expected_output: An academic model-architecture figure using modules and deep-learning semantic types rather than generic boxes.
assertions: Uses drawio-academic-skills overlay policy for the publication-facing request
Sets meta.profile to academic-paper and meta.figureType to architecture
Uses modules for stages such as input, backbone, fusion or neck, head, and loss/output
Uses deep-learning semantic node types such as input, conv, pool, attention, tensor3d, loss, and output
Keeps labels compact and uses a legend or caption instead of long prose inside layer blocks
Honors the requested .drawio and .svg while labeling live-text SVG as draft-preview because no publication target was supplied
Keeps .spec.yaml, .arch.json, and manifest in .drawio-tmp/<name>/

evals.prompt: Create a publication-ready max-pooling operation figure using native draw.io cells. Show a 2 x 2 input window, the max operation, the output value, a short formula, and arrow labels that do not overlap connector lines.
evals.expected_output: A compact academic operation figure built from native grid cells, formula/text nodes, and offset connector labels.
assertions: Sets meta.profile to academic-paper and maps the operation to an existing meta.figureType value
Builds the grid from native editable draw.io cells instead of embedding a raster image
Uses explicit bounds for grid cells, formula, and callout or label placement
Uses supported math delimiters for the formula
Uses labelOffset or equivalent placement so edge labels sit off connector lines
Verifies the selected delivery class's exported artifact before any ad hoc browser screenshot

evals.prompt: Create an ablation-study figure comparing a baseline and two variants before a shared evaluation block for a conference paper.
evals.expected_output: A workflow-style ablation pipeline suitable for publication.
assertions: Sets meta.figureType to workflow
Shows baseline and at least two variant branches
Branches converge at shared evaluation
Includes legend or caption guidance when line styles or colors encode meaning

evals.prompt: I have a draft optimization paper about traffic-signal control. Build a publication figure from the paper logic, not just a list of sections: problem gap, sensor data, assumptions, multi-agent controller, simulation scenarios, metrics, results, and contribution. Use an image-generation concept preview if appropriate, but don't send raw unpublished text externally without asking.
evals.expected_output: A paper-derived academic figure workflow that extracts the research evidence chain, confirms a diagram plan, optionally uses privacy-gated image preview, then renders editable draw.io artifacts.
assertions: Identifies the source as a paper-derived figure and extracts a research evidence chain
Maps the figure to an existing meta.figureType value rather than inventing a new schema field
Presents a diagram plan for confirmation before rendering
Uses optional image-generation preview only after plan confirmation and privacy approval
Keeps YAML as the canonical spec, .drawio as the editable source, and marks SVG as draft-preview until a publication target is fixed

evals.prompt: Create an A4-safe thesis figure for Word export. Deliver the editable source and the correct Word-ready publication artifact even if draw.io Desktop is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: A raster-publication bundle with editable drawio and a verified 300ppi-effective PNG.
assertions: Performs venue/audience preflight for thesis or Word
Sets manifest.contract.delivery_class to raster-publication
Requires .drawio and a 300ppi-effective PNG, with sidecars and manifest in a work directory
Uses a source-preserving browser-rasterized PNG under the derivative gate when Desktop is unavailable
Does not treat live-text SVG as the final Word publication asset

evals.prompt: Create a publication-ready training pipeline figure with a visible loss formula $$L = -\sum y_i \log(\hat{y}_i)$$ and an inline metric note \(F_1\).
evals.expected_output: A formula-bearing academic workflow figure with formula and text fidelity checks.
assertions: Loads or follows math-typesetting guidance from sibling base
Uses only official math delimiters
Keeps formulas readable and unclipped
Sets meta.profile to academic-paper and meta.figureType to workflow

evals.prompt: Replicate the uploaded academic figure into an editable bundle. Preserve caption, legend, formula block, standalone text boxes, and edge labels with their relative positions.
evals.expected_output: An academic replication bundle with explicit text placement and label offsets.
assertions: Sets meta.source to replicated
Sets meta.profile to academic-paper
Uses explicit bounds for standalone text, captions, formulas, or callouts when placement matters
Uses labelOffset for connector labels that would otherwise sit on lines
Records a visual/text-position self-check before completion
Uses the selected delivery class's exported artifact for visual verification before any ad hoc browser screenshot

evals.prompt: Redraw the uploaded research framework screenshot as an editable scientific draw.io figure. Preserve section labels, caption, legend, formulas, callouts, and connector labels, but rebuild the main diagram as native cells rather than pasting the screenshot as the page.
evals.expected_output: A scientific reference redraw workflow with source inventory, native editable cells, explicit text placement, and exported-artifact verification.
assertions: Sets meta.source to replicated and meta.profile to academic-paper
Creates or presents a source inventory for canvas, regions, shapes, text, formulas, connectors, palette, and uncertainties
Uses native draw.io shapes, text/formula nodes, modules, waypoints, and labelOffset for the main figure
Does not embed the uploaded reference image as the final full-page draw.io content
Preserves captions, legends, formulas, callouts, and connector labels as first-class elements
Uses the selected delivery class's exported artifact for visual verification before any ad hoc browser screenshot

evals.prompt: Redraw the uploaded framework screenshot as a cleaner journal figure. Improve the hierarchy and academic tone, but preserve the visible caption, legend, callouts, and edge labels. Use a visual concept preview before final draw.io if that helps, then deliver editable .drawio and .svg with sidecars in a work directory.
evals.expected_output: An academic image-improvement workflow that confirms extracted structure, uses optional image preview for layout approval, then verifies exported draw.io artifacts.
assertions: Confirms ambiguous source text or extracted structure before final rendering
Uses optional image-generation preview for academic improvement or layout exploration when available
Falls back to local YAML/SVG preview when image generation is unavailable or declined
Treats the explicitly requested live-text SVG as draft-preview unless a publication target is separately fixed
Uses explicit bounds or labelOffset for captions, callouts, formulas, or connector labels when placement matters
Performs one exported-artifact QA pass and rerenders once if visible defects are found

evals.prompt: Export the final paper figure as PNG and PDF for submission, but draw.io Desktop might not be installed.
evals.expected_output: A vector-submission workflow with a PNG companion that uses each format's honest fallback or blocked state.
assertions: Sets vector-submission as the primary class and treats PNG as a requested companion
Attempts Desktop PNG/PDF through the sibling base when available
Does not require MCP or a live backend
Uses the derivative-gate browser-rasterized PNG fallback when Desktop is unavailable
Reports vector-submission blocked when no accepted PDF/path-capable exporter exists
Still delivers .drawio, work-dir sidecars/manifest, and any explicitly labeled draft preview
Does not substitute an ad hoc Playwright screenshot for a publication artifact

evals.prompt: Create an IEEE camera-ready workflow figure for single-column print. I have not selected a palette.
evals.expected_output: An academic preflight that recommends an IEEE print-safe palette, records it independently from the theme, and passes the print gate.
assertions: Determines the IEEE print venue before asking one palette question
Offers ieee-bw first with (Recommended), followed by relevant alternatives such as tol-high-contrast and ieee-color
States colorblind and grayscale safety in the option descriptions
Sets meta.palette to the selected palette and meta.print.target to ieee-single
Uses the academic theme for typography and layout independently from palette colors
Runs strict validation and reports the selected palette plus its safety flags

evals.prompt: Create a Nature-style online journal figure using the journal-npg palette. This is a color PDF, not a grayscale print deliverable.
evals.expected_output: An academic workflow that applies the explicitly named palette without asking again and reports its accessibility metadata.
assertions: Maps journal-npg directly to meta.palette and does not ask a palette-selection question
Keeps academic theme typography, layout, shapes, and line styles independent from the palette
Surfaces PALETTE_CVD_NOTICE as non-blocking info because journal-npg is not colorblind-safe
Does not invent a grayscale print requirement for the explicitly online color deliverable
Sets delivery_class to vector-submission for the requested PDF
Names journal-npg and its colorblind and grayscale safety flags in the completion report

evals.prompt: Create an IEEE single-column camera-ready workflow figure using the morandi palette.
evals.expected_output: An academic print workflow that honors the explicit palette request, surfaces the grayscale print risk, and recommends a print-safe downgrade.
assertions: Maps morandi directly to meta.palette and does not ask a palette-selection question
Sets meta.print.target to ieee-single for the camera-ready deliverable
Surfaces PALETTE_PRINT_GATE because morandi is not grayscale-safe for the print target
Recommends downgrading to ieee-bw or tol-high-contrast, or keeps the strict validation failure explicit
Reports morandi's colorblind and grayscale safety flags in the completion report

evals.prompt: Turn the supplied multi-page architecture bundle into a paper-ready figure set, using the sibling base offline postprocess summary before applying publication checks.
evals.expected_output: A publication-checked bundle that consumes base multi-page and postprocess contracts without duplicating runtime.
assertions: Uses sibling base canonical bundle and postprocess behavior
Applies academic caption, print, and readability checks after the base transform
Does not copy adapters, identity, renderer, catalogs, or postprocess runtime into the overlay
Keeps Desktop and model evidence classifications honest

evals.prompt: Create a formal manuscript figure with an operational closed loop as the horizontal reading path and a separate capability-evolution ladder as the vertical dimension. Several technical abbreviations appear in the source.
evals.expected_output: A publication-ready two-axis scientific figure whose process and progression semantics remain distinct, self-contained, and readable at page scale.
assertions: Declares one primary process axis and one contextual progression axis with distinct visual treatment
Audits the operational loop and capability progression independently
Uses source --relation--> target for every ambiguous or non-primary arrow
Does not add cross-axis arrows unless the source supports a causal, temporal, or explicit mapping relation
Expands every Latin-letter abbreviation at first figure-visible use or defines it earlier in a figure-internal legend or caption
Splits the figure instead of shrinking text when cross-axis mappings or labels become dense
Checks A4 readability, grayscale meaning, caption or legend integrity, and arrow semantics before completion

evals.prompt: Produce a PNG companion from this final academic SVG containing centered Chinese text. Preserve the SVG, and verify that the PNG is suitable for formal Word publication even if draw.io Desktop is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: A source-preserving, publication-checked raster derivative with honest renderer provenance and alignment evidence.
assertions: Preserves and hashes the source SVG for conversion-only scope
Uses Desktop when available, or labels a local browser-engine fallback as browser-rasterized rather than Desktop-exported
Matches the SVG viewBox aspect ratio with an explicit viewport and scale
Checks CJK baseline fidelity across a representative label before selecting a renderer
Records dimensions, color mode or background, renderer, viewport, scale, and text-centering measurements
Rechecks clipping, arrowheads, connector attachment, borders, legend, grayscale meaning, and page-scale readability

evals.prompt: Create a paper figure with a horizontal operational loop and a separate vertical capability-evolution axis. Keep all supplied labels and relations unchanged.
evals.expected_output: A compact comparison of two or three structurally distinct plans followed by one recorded selection before YAML authoring.
assertions: Queries the local reference index before inventing a layout from scratch
Presents two or three candidate IDs with main axis, use-when condition, and principal risk
Keeps the same semantic inventory across candidates
Records one selected layout and a scientific-argument-based reason before detailed YAML
Does not render all candidates unless the user explicitly requests it

evals.prompt: Use a bundled academic example as a layout prior for a compact neural-network architecture figure, but do not copy its labels or data.
evals.expected_output: A local, license-recorded reference selection that adopts abstract layout features only.
assertions: Uses a stable reference ID from the overlay-local index
Records the bundled source and MIT license metadata
States which abstract features are adopted and which source content is not copied
Preserves the current task's labels, relations, formulas, data, and trademarks
Requires source/version, license review, and code audit before adding an external executable reference

evals.prompt: Finalize this complex academic architecture and leave a machine-readable record of the frozen semantics, chosen layout, artifacts, checks, and provenance.
evals.expected_output: A strict-valid figure manifest whose artifact claims are hash-backed and whose unknown evidence stays explicit.
assertions: Records stable node and edge IDs plus source --relation--> target semantics
Records compared and selected layout IDs with a non-empty selection reason
Records reference IDs, exact sibling-base commands, artifact roles, evidence labels, hashes, and sizes
Records exactly one delivery_class and rejects a strict manifest whose primary artifact does not match it
Keeps deterministic, visual, and publication QA separate
Uses pending, not_checked, blocked, or residual risk instead of inventing PASS evidence
